create_client_inference: create an InferenceClient instance with a custom base_url and api_key for a local LLM endpoint
create_chat_completion: create a chat completion request using InferenceClient with model name and user messages
build_chat_messages: build a list of chat messages with role and content fields for a chat completion call
test_chat_completions_create: test the chat.completions.create method on an InferenceClient with a model and messages
summarize_completion_response: summarize the completion response by accessing choices[0].message from the chat completion result
